t: You're looking at a bust of Robert Devereux, the third Earl of Essex, a sculpture attributed to Caius Gabriel Cibber. Essex was an English nobleman and soldier. When the Civil War began in 1642, he became the first Captain-General of the Parliamentarian army, the Roundheads. He was unwilling or unable to deliver a decisive blow against the Royalists, was overshadowed by Cromwell and Fairfax, and resigned in 1646. Cibber was a Danish sculptor who found great success in England, and was appointed carver to the king's closet by William the Third.
